note: Dated entries drop off after their date. Undated notices drop off on their expires date.

items.title: English class goes to the library
items.detail: Checkout day. A book is expected in class every day after this for independent reading. She can bring one from home before Friday if she wants to start sooner.

items.title: English supplies in her bag
items.detail: Spiral notebook was due Aug 19. Folder, pencils, highlighters and headphones or earbuds due Aug 20. Not graded, but she needs them to work in class. Extra pencils, highlighters and tissues are welcome for the classroom.

items.title: Orchestra financial assistance rental form closes
items.detail: Only applies if you are requesting a school owned instrument. Otherwise ignore and wait for the general rental window.

items.title: Violin comes to school for the first time
items.detail: Grade 6 start date. Strings is block 4B, so the violin goes in on B and D days only and comes home the same day. Bring it in earlier if it still needs finger tapes.

items.title: No Art 6 supply list yet
items.detail: Five of six teachers have sent syllabi. Nothing from Ms. Thiele. Expect a supply ask in the first weeks.

items.title: Violin chosen, rental and fitting still to do
items.detail: Rent from a shop and have her sized in person. The directors name Day Violins and say not to buy online. Needs rosin, a shoulder rest, a tuner, a cleaning cloth, a case tag and a home music stand.
